title: 第451章 偷袭踢一脚再打一拳第450章 法宝碎三件
slug: 谁让这小子升执法长老的
content_zh:
白尊身后那股气息升起来的时候，丹峰半山所有人都往后退了半步。
那不是天尊该有的力量。
曹立停在原地，看着白尊掌心碎开的玉符，又看了看他背后那团正在凝聚的虚影。
白尊喘得厉害，法袍破了，肩膀塌着，脸上还带着血。
丹峰弟子听到这话，心都提了起来。
有人小声开口。
“这是圣人符？”
“应该是圣主给圣子的护身符。”
“圣子把这东西都用了？”
“曹立再猛，也不可能接圣人之力吧？”
白尊听见周围声音，胸口那股郁气总算顺了一点。
他被曹立压着打了这么久，法宝碎了三件，人也被打到半跪在地。
这口气不吐出去，他今天真要被钉在丹峰的笑话柱上。
曹立站在几丈外，身上的血还没干，后背也有伤。
可他没急着动手，只是看着那股气息继续往上顶。
白尊抬起手。
那股力量悬在他背后，像是随时能压下来。“怎么，不敢了？”
曹立点头。“对的，我不敢。”
白尊愣住。
丹峰弟子也愣住。

他们原本以为曹立会硬怼一句，然后正面冲上去。
结果曹立认了？
有人当场来了精神。
“他怕了！”
“废话，那可是圣人层次的力量，谁不怕？”
“曹立终于知道怕了。”
白尊也缓过来，胸口那股憋屈刚要散开，曹立又开口了。
“你都要作弊了，我为什么要接？”
半山一下安静。
白尊脸上的那点气势僵住。
曹立摊开手。
“你九品大圆满打我八品大圆满，打输了就算了，现在打不过就掏法宝，法宝碎了又掏圣人符。”
“你还问我敢不敢接？”
“我是不是傻？我八品天尊接你一个圣人符？”
丹峰弟子张了张嘴，没人接得上。
这话太难听，可又有点道理。
刚才白尊用法宝，大家还能说那是圣子底蕴，现在圣人符一出，确实有点不讲武德。
本来就境界碾压，现在还要作弊。
白尊胸口猛地起伏了一下。“你少废话！”
曹立往旁边挪了一步。

“你急什么？”
“这应该就是你的绝招吧？”
白尊咬着牙，背后那股力量又压低了一点。
content_en:
When the aura behind Bai Zun rose, everyone in the Danfeng Mountain took half a step back.
That is not the power Tianzun should have.
Cao Li stopped where he was, looking at the broken jade talisman in Bai Zun's palm, and then at the gathering shadow behind him.
Bai Zun was breathing heavily, his robe was torn, his shoulders were slumped, and there was blood on his face.
When the Danfeng disciples heard this, their hearts were lifted.
Someone spoke softly.
"Is this a saint's talisman?"
"It should be the amulet given by the Holy Lord to the Holy Son."
"The Holy Son has used all these things?"
"No matter how fierce Cao Li is, he can't take on the power of a saint, right?"
Bai Zun heard the sounds around him, and the depression in his chest finally calmed down a little.
He was pressed down and beaten by Cao Li for so long that three magic weapons were broken and he was beaten until he was half kneeling on the ground.
If he didn't spit out this breath, he would really be nailed on Danfeng's joke pillar today.
Cao Li stood a few feet away. The blood on his body had not dried yet, and his back was injured.
But he didn't rush to take action, he just watched the breath continue to push upward.
Bai Zun raised his hand.
The power hung behind him, as if it could be suppressed at any time. "What, you don't dare anymore?"
Cao Li nodded. "Yes, I don't dare."
Bai Zun was stunned.
Danfeng disciples were also stunned.
They originally thought that Cao Li would give him a tough retort and then charge forward.
In the end, Cao Li admitted it?
Someone perked up on the spot.
"He's scared!"
"Nonsense, that is the power of a saint, who is not afraid of it?"
"Cao Li finally realized that he was afraid."
Bai Zun also regained his composure, and just as the aggravation in his chest was about to dissipate, Cao Li spoke again.
"You're going to cheat, why should I answer?"
It's quiet halfway up the mountain.
The aura on Bai Zun's face froze.
Cao Li spread his hands.
"Your ninth-level Dzogchen beats me to the eighth-level Dzogchen. If you lose, forget it. Now if you can't beat me, take out the magic weapon. If the magic weapon breaks, take out the saint's talisman."
"You asked me if I dare to accept it?"
"Am I stupid? I, the Eighth-Rank Heavenly Lord, will give you a Saint Talisman?"
The Danfeng disciples opened their mouths, but no one could answer them.
This is an ugly thing to say, but it makes sense.
When Bai Zun used the magic weapon just now, everyone could still say that it was the foundation of the Holy Son. Now that the Saint Talisman is out, it is indeed a bit ungrateful.
I was already crushing my realm, but now I have to cheat.
Bai Zun's chest rose and fell suddenly. "Stop talking nonsense!"
Cao Li took a step to the side.
"What are you in a hurry for?"
"This should be your special move, right?"
Bai Zun gritted his teeth, and the force behind him lowered a little.
